sources: sizes: the hotel's own capacity chart, on its events page (https://www.marriott.com/en-us/hotels/atlpl-the-westin-peachtree-plaza-atlanta/events/, read 2026-10-03)

placement, order and orientation: the hotel's own floor plan, reference/plans/westin-floorplans-old.pdf, p. 8, measured from the centre of the ring of columns round the tower. The plan is from before the hotel's renovation, when these rooms were International A to H, the Boardroom, the American Room and Vinings I and II; it is drawn south up, and is turned half a turn here (DECISIONS #28: read for position only, nothing copied)

today's names, room for room: the hotel's current floor plan of this floor, a picture on its events page (the same address; reference/plans/westin-site-2026-floor-6.png), which draws the walls where the old plan does
which rooms the con uses and which way is north: Dragon Con's 2026 map, reference/dragoncon/ (read only)
notes: the lowest of the three meeting floors in the base of the hotel, under the round tower: the Chastain rooms east of the tower, towards Peachtree Street, Chastain 1 and 2 in the west wing, and the Overlook north of that wing

the plan's rooms are today's under other names, each within a few feet of its row in today's chart: Chastain A to E are the plan's American Room, Boardroom and International A, B and C, west to east along the north side; F to J are its International D to H, east to west along the south side; Chastain 1 and 2 are its Vinings I and II
only the rooms the venues file holds are drawn: Chastain A, B and C are on the plan, west of D, and had no 2026 programming
the west wing's west wall slants, so Chastain 1 and 2 are trapezoids; they are drawn as rectangles at the chart's sizes from the wing's straight east wall

Chastain F to J stand on the south wall they share at the chart's depths, 37 to 46 ft, as the plan draws them; D and E on the corridor. Chastain I, 37 ft, stops short of the corridor: the plan draws a door recess, about 6 ft, between the two

Chastain E is an L on the plan, about 49 ft wide: the chart's 51 ft deep over the 12 ft at its east end, 44 over the next 12 and 37 over its western half, behind a door recess off the corridor; about 2,020 sq ft, against the chart's 2,157. It is drawn as the chart's 52 x 51, the L's bounding box
the Atrium is the open floor round the tower, drawn by eye; Convention information is Dragon Con's map's, in the hallway, placed by eye
